summary: First full MVP test of Waheeba Fashion. Fixed 2 startup bugs (admin user seeding blocked by storage error; chatbot GET/POST method mismatch) and comprehensively tested backend (25/25 pytest passing) and frontend (Home, Products, Product Detail, Cart, Auth, Account, Admin dashboard, Chatbot, Offers, About, Contact all working).

minor.issue: Endpoint requires POST but signature uses only Query params - consider making it accept both methods or converting to GET for SSE consistency
Storage init fails with 400 Bad Request against integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init - non-blocking now (isolated try/except) but object storage uploads may fail

action_items: Verify object storage integration - currently init fails with 400. If admin plans to upload product images through /api/upload, this needs to be fixed (storage.py). Not blocking current flow because seeded products use Unsplash URLs.
(Optional) Consider making /api/chat/message accept GET as well, since it uses only query params - would prevent future frontend/backend method mismatches.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup(): originally combined init_storage() and admin creation in one try/except. Storage init raising blocked admin user creation entirely. FIXED by separating into two try/except blocks.
Chatbot.js: fetch() defaulted to GET but backend chat endpoint was defined as POST -> 405 Method Not Allowed. FIXED by adding {method: 'POST'} to fetch options.

server.py get_products(): sort logic is buggy for 'price_asc' etc. - `sort_field = 'price' if 'price' in sort_by else sort_by` sets field to 'price' but `sort_order` uses -1 for 'price_desc' via substring match. Works for common cases but brittle.
server.py chat_message() streaming: closes over shared session doc but doesn't handle client disconnect - assistant message may not be saved if client aborts.
server.py: file grew close to ~720 lines - fine for MVP but consider splitting routers (auth/products/cart/orders/admin/chat) for maintainability.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@waheebafashion.com / admin123 (auto-seeded now that startup fix applied). Test users are created dynamically per test with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: 8 products already seeded via /app/backend/seed_data.py. Backend tests create ephemeral TEST_ users and one test order (WF... order visible in admin dashboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully tested via /app/backend/tests/test_waheeba_backend.py using pytest-xdist (25 tests, ~8s). Frontend flows verified: Home hero + featured products, Products grid + search + filters (via UI), Product Detail with color/size selects (single-variant products auto-select), Add-to-cart working (cart drawer opens showing item with SAR 30 delivery), Auth register/login, 50 welcome loyalty points visible on Account, Admin dashboard shows stats (8 products, orders, users, revenue) and recent orders, Chatbot streams Arabic AI responses via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + gpt-5.4-mini. WhatsApp FAB and Chatbot FAB visible on all pages. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/home_final.png, admin_page.png, account_page.png. Public URL: https://dress-gallery-87.preview.emergentagent.com

rca_of_the_issues.admin_login_401: Root cause: startup() had init_storage() and admin user creation inside SAME try/except. Storage init hits external Emergent object-store endpoint returning 400, exception propagated and admin seeding was skipped -> DB never had admin@waheebafashion.com -> login returned 401 Invalid credentials. Fix: split into two try/except blocks so admin seeding runs even if storage init fails. Verified: admin login now returns 200 with token and is_admin=true.
rca_of_the_issues.chatbot_405: Root cause: backend @api_router.post('/chat/message') but frontend Chatbot.js used fetch() default GET method. Result: 405 Method Not Allowed, chatbot showed empty assistant reply. Fix: Added {method: 'POST'} to fetch. Verified: chatbot streams full Arabic response about sizes.
